preferences.note: Prefers deep architecture scenarios over theoretical trivia

roles.title: Backend Developer
roles.description: Looking for an experienced backend engineer to architect resilient, high-volume microservices using FastAPI, MongoDB, and modern caching architectures.

evaluationRubric.Python Fundamentals: Deep mastery of async/await, memory management, and concurrency.
evaluationRubric.API Design: REST principles, idempotent endpoints, error handling, rate limiting.
evaluationRubric.Database Architecture: Schema design, compound indexes, B-tree lookups, aggregation pipeline tuning.
evaluationRubric.System Design: Scalability, caching strategies, backpressure, distributed consensus.

roles.title: Frontend Developer
roles.description: Design intuitive, ultra-fast interfaces for complex data workflows with React and TypeScript.

evaluationRubric.React & Component Architecture: Clean separation of concerns, custom hooks, atomic components.

roles.title: Machine Learning Engineer
roles.description: Scale our generative intelligence models, fine-tune domain-specific agents, and optimize production inference latencies.

evaluationRubric.ML Fundamentals: Attention mechanisms, loss function formulation, evaluation metrics.
evaluationRubric.Production Deployment: Serving architectures, model quantization, latency optimization.

resume.summary: Backend Developer with 2 years of hands-on experience designing REST APIs and microservices using Python, FastAPI, MongoDB, and Docker.
projects: High-throughput REST API Gateway with FastAPI and Redis caching
Document indexing pipeline for high-concurrency order catalog

resume.summary: Frontend Engineer with 4 years building interactive SaaS applications with React, TypeScript, and modern CSS.
resume.education: B.E. in Information Technology, Osmania University
projects: Real-time analytics dashboard with React and WebSockets
Design system component library adopted across 12 teams

resume.summary: ML Engineer specializing in natural language processing, vector retrieval systems, and PyTorch model fine-tuning.
resume.education: M.Tech in Artificial Intelligence, IIT Hyderabad
projects: Domain-specific semantic search engine handling 2M embeddings
Text classification pipeline with 94% F1 score

interviews.feedback: Strong Python fundamentals. Good understanding of APIs. Weak understanding of database indexing.
strengths: Clear explanations of asynchronous event loops
weaknesses: Could not explain B-tree lookup vs full table scan
questions: How does Python asyncio event loop manage I/O bound concurrency?
How do you structure RESTful API endpoints for idempotent operations?
How does MongoDB implement indexing, and what is the difference between B-tree and hash indexes?
interviews.notes: Passed screening comfortably on language fundamentals, but database internals require close attention in Round 2.

interviews.feedback: Excellent communication. Good API design. Still struggled with database optimization. Could not clearly explain indexing strategies. Weak system design explanation.
strengths: Good API design and validation practices
Thorough understanding of HTTP error handling and payloads
weaknesses: Could not clearly explain indexing strategies
Weak system design explanation when asked to scale horizontally
questions: How would you design a distributed rate limiter in FastAPI backed by Redis?
Suppose a MongoDB aggregate query is taking 3.5 seconds in production. How do you analyze the explain plan and optimize it?
How would you scale this microservice horizontally when database reads become the primary bottleneck?
interviews.notes: Strong culture fit and API fundamentals. The repeated struggle with database indexing and query optimization is our main concern for Round 3.

interviews.feedback: Deep knowledge of React 18 concurrency, hook mechanics, and TypeScript generic types.
weaknesses: Limited knowledge of Webpack custom plugins and bundle analysis
questions: Explain how React 18 uses fiber architecture and automatic batching.
Build a type-safe generic autocomplete component in TypeScript.

interviews.feedback: Solid mathematical background in attention mechanisms and loss optimization, but lacking experience in production inference serving.
questions: Derive scaled dot-product attention and explain why scaling is necessary.
How would you serve this PyTorch model with sub-50ms latency under high load?
interviews.notes: Great researcher; need to probe production serving in next round.

interviews.feedback: Candidate demonstrated solid Python fundamentals and REST API patterns. However, had significant gaps in database indexing and MongoDB query execution planning.
questions: How does Python garbage collection and reference counting work?
How does MongoDB handle indexing under the hood?

interviews.feedback: Candidate demonstrated marked improvement in MongoDB indexing and explain plan analysis. Gaps identified in distributed consensus and handling network partitions in microservices.
questions: How do you analyze a MongoDB explain plan?
How do you handle compound index selectivity?

memories.title: Resume & Baseline Qualifications
memories.content: Candidate Rahul Sharma has 2 years of backend engineering experience with Python, FastAPI, MongoDB, REST APIs, and Docker. Applied for Senior Backend Developer.

memories.title: Round 1 Technical Screening
memories.content: Technical screening covered Python core, asyncio concurrency, and MongoDB indexing. Candidate performed strongly on Python and API routing, but struggled with B-tree index concepts.

memories.title: Strength Observed: Python Fundamentals
memories.content: In Round 1, candidate demonstrated proficiency: "Strong Python fundamentals, good grasp of language constructs."

memories.title: Strength Observed: API Design
memories.content: In Round 1, candidate demonstrated proficiency: "Good understanding of REST APIs and endpoint conventions."

memories.title: Area to Investigate: Database Indexing
memories.content: In Round 1, candidate exhibited gap or difficulty: "Weak understanding of database indexing and B-tree lookup mechanics."

memories.title: Round 2 API & Architecture Round
memories.content: Architectural evaluation focusing on rate limiting, query optimization, and horizontal scalability. Candidate was articulate and designed clean API boundaries, but struggled again with database optimization and horizontal scaling.

memories.title: Strength Observed: Communication
memories.content: In Round 2, candidate demonstrated proficiency: "Excellent communication and professional technical presentation."

memories.title: Strength Observed: API Design
memories.content: In Round 2, candidate demonstrated proficiency: "Good API design and structured validation handling."

memories.title: Area to Investigate: Query Optimization
memories.content: In Round 2, candidate exhibited gap or difficulty: "Still struggled with database optimization and explain plan interpretation."

memories.title: Area to Investigate: Indexing Strategies
memories.content: In Round 2, candidate exhibited gap or difficulty: "Could not clearly explain indexing strategies for compound queries."

memories.title: Area to Investigate: System Design
memories.content: In Round 2, candidate exhibited gap or difficulty: "Weak system design explanation when asked to scale horizontally."

memories.title: Strength Observed: React Architecture
memories.content: In Round 1, candidate demonstrated exceptional understanding of React 18 fiber reconciler and hooks.

memories.title: Area to Investigate: Model Latency Profiling
memories.content: In Round 1, candidate showed limited knowledge of TensorRT and sub-50ms inference deployment.
